legend: You are given an undirected graph with N%%ZSMJ0%% nodes and a list of edges of size M%%ZSMJ1%%. You are asked to partition the given list of edges into minimum number of contiguous and disjoint subsequences such that every subsequence describes a bipartite graph. Please note, the graphs formed by different subsequences are completely independent.
input: The first line of the input contains the integers N%%ZSMJ2%% (2≤N≤200000%%ZSMJ3%%) and M%%ZSMJ4%% (1≤M≤200000%%ZSMJ5%%), denoting the number of nodes and the size of the edge list.
Each of the following M%%ZSMJ6%% lines contains 2%%ZSMJ7%% positive integers, denoting an edge between nodes x%%ZSMJ8%% and y%%ZSMJ9%% (1≤x,y≤N,x≠y%%ZSMJ10%%).
output: On a single line, print the minimum number of subsequences to partition the given list of edges such that every graph inside a subsequence is bipartite.
